page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c8ae family. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T34 processors running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or integrated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 20 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 3111.48, placing it in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance falls into the average tier, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 49846.52 and a PassMark CPU score of 47465.6. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 (AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16) and cryptography standards like AES and SHA_NI. This cryptographic capability is reflected in a strong PassMark CPU encryption score of 38961.53. Memory performance is also notable, with a PassMark memory score of 2882.22, placing it in the top 25%, while uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidths are 96.08 GB/sec and 56.28 GB/sec respectively.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-optimized option, offering high compute capacity per unit of memory. The lack of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, requiring network storage for all persistent data. The instance is suited for compute-heavy workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores and vector extensions, such as web serving, cryptographic processing, and multi-threaded data decompression.
